title: Circuit Board/PCB
content: Apply circuit board/PCB aesthetic with electronics hardware feel. PCB green (#006400) or blue base color. Copper trace patterns connecting points. Component footprints and solder pads. Through-hole and SMD component representations. Silkscreen white text labels. Via holes (small circles). IC chip rectangles with pins. Include circuit paths as decorative elements. Hardware engineering atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create electronic circuit board aesthetic with traces, components, and PCB green color scheme.
variants.detailed: Apply circuit board/PCB aesthetic with electronics hardware feel. PCB green (#006400) or blue base color. Copper trace patterns connecting points. Component footprints and solder pads. Through-hole and SMD component representations. Silkscreen white text labels. Via holes (small circles). IC chip rectangles with pins. Include circuit paths as decorative elements. Hardware engineering atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply circuit board/PCB aesthetic with authentic electronics design feel. Base colors: classic PCB green (#0a5c36, solder mask), PCB blue (#1a365d), PCB red (#7c1d1d), or matte black for modern boards. Copper traces: golden-copper color (#b87333, #d97706) lines connecting components, consistent width, 45/90 degree angles (no arbitrary curves). Trace patterns: parallel traces, bus lines, ground planes (copper fill areas with thermal relief). Solder pads: circular or rectangular copper areas, gold finish (#ffd700) for ENIG. Through-holes: circles with copper ring and dark center hole. Via holes: small filled circles connecting layers, sometimes tented (covered). Components: resistors (rectangle with bands), capacitors (cylinders or rectangles), IC chips (rectangle with pins on sides, dot for pin 1), connectors (multi-pin headers). Silkscreen: white (#ffffff) text labels, component outlines, version numbers, logos - slightly rough printing texture. Solder mask: slight texture, soldermask-defined pads. Board edge: milled edge profile, mounting holes in corners. Reference designators: R1, C1, U1 labels near components. Test points: labeled TP1, TP2 circles. Layers: suggestion of multi-layer board (via stitching). Fiducials: circular or cross-shaped alignment marks. Interactive: trace highlighting, component hover info. Implementation: SVG for circuit patterns, careful line work for traces. Accessibility: ensure any text is readable against busy PCB pattern.
